testSuite.name: test_fixed30_high_sensitivity
testSuite.description: Rule 1: High rate sensitivity should result in Fixed30 even if other rules match.

testSuite.name: test_fixed30_explicit_preference
testSuite.description: Rule 1: Explicit fixed rate preference should result in Fixed30.

testSuite.name: test_arm71_standard_match
testSuite.description: Rule 2: Typical parameters for ARM 7/1.

testSuite.name: test_arm71_boundary_conditions
testSuite.description: Rule 2: Boundary values (7 years, 80% LTV, 720 score) should match ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: test_manual_low_credit_score
testSuite.description: Rule 3: Credit score below 640 should trigger ManualReview.

testSuite.name: test_manual_high_dti
testSuite.description: Rule 3: DTI above 50 should trigger ManualReview (when Rule 2 doesn't match).

testSuite.name: test_manual_high_ltv
testSuite.description: Rule 3: LTV above 95 should trigger ManualReview (when Rule 2 doesn't match).

testSuite.name: test_precedence_rule1_over_rule3
testSuite.description: Precedence Check: Rule 1 (Fixed30) should win over Rule 3 (ManualReview) due to Hit Policy: FIRST.

testSuite.name: test_precedence_rule1_over_rule2
testSuite.description: Precedence Check: Rule 1 (Fixed30) should win over Rule 2 (ARM7/1) due to Hit Policy: FIRST.

testSuite.name: test_precedence_rule2_over_rule3
testSuite.description: Precedence Check: Rule 2 (ARM7/1) should win over Rule 3 (ManualReview) due to Hit Policy: FIRST.

testSuite.name: test_no_rules_applied
testSuite.description: No rules apply: criteria for ARM7/1 not met and criteria for ManualReview not met.

testSuite.name: test_arm71_fail_on_stability
testSuite.description: Rule 2 fails: Income stability is not 'stable'.

testSuite.name: test_arm71_fail_on_credit_boundary
testSuite.description: Rule 2 fails: Credit score 719 is below 720.

testSuite.name: test_manual_boundary_dti
testSuite.description: Rule 3 fails: DTI is exactly 50 (must be > 50).

testSuite.name: test_manual_boundary_ltv
testSuite.description: Rule 3 fails: LTV is exactly 95 (must be > 95).

cases.description: Fixed30 через явну фіксовану перевагу
Fixed30 через високу чутливість до ставки
ARM7/1: короткий горизонт + стабільний профіль

Конфлікт ARM7/1 vs Fixed (пріоритет → Fixed30)
Виконуються умови ARM7/1, але fixedPreference=true → очікувано: Fixed30

ManualReview через низький кредитний бал
Очікувано: ManualReview (бо creditScore < 640)

ManualReview через високий DTI
Очікувано: ManualReview (бо dti > 50)

ManualReview через високий LTV
Очікувано: ManualReview (бо ltv > 95)

Нейтральний сценарій (жодне правило не підходить)
Очікувано: null або дефолтне рішення (залежно від політики у DMN)
Фіксована перевага + кредитний бал 600 → відсічка переважає
Фіксована перевага + DTI 55 → відсічка переважає
Фіксована перевага + LTV 97 → відсічка переважає
Висока чутливість до ставки + кредитний бал 620 → відсічка переважає
Висока чутливість до ставки + DTI 60 → відсічка переважає
Висока чутливість до ставки + LTV 98 → відсічка переважає
Умови ARM7/1 виконані + DTI 51 → відсічка переважає (кейс зі смоук-прогону)
Умови ARM7/1 виконані + DTI 75 → відсічка переважає
Умови ARM7/1 + висока чутливість до ставки → Fixed30
Умови ARM7/1 + фіксована перевага і висока чутливість → Fixed30

Кредитний бал 639 → відсічка

LTV рівно 95 → не відсічка (умова «вище 95»)
LTV 95.1 → відсічка

Умови ARM, LTV 80.5 → жодне правило
Умови ARM, горизонт рівно 7 років → ARM7/1 (умова «сім років або менше»)
Умови ARM, горизонт 7.5 року → жодне правило

Середня чутливість, без переваги, довгий горизонт → жодне правило

Фіксована перевага, кредитний бал рівно 640 → Fixed30 (відсічки немає)

        </inputEntry>

        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-7">
          <text>> 50</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-5-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-6">
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-2">
          <text></text>

testSuite.name: Rule 1: Fixed Preference
testSuite.description: Applicant explicitly requested a fixed rate.

testSuite.name: Rule 1: High Rate Sensitivity
testSuite.description: Applicant has high sensitivity to rate changes.

testSuite.name: Rule 2: Standard ARM 7/1
testSuite.description: Meets all criteria for 7/1 ARM: stable income, low LTV, good score, short horizon.

testSuite.name: Rule 3: Low Credit Score
testSuite.description: Applicant has a credit score below 640.

testSuite.name: Rule 3: High DTI
testSuite.description: Applicant has a DTI ratio over 50.

testSuite.name: Rule 3: High LTV
testSuite.description: Applicant has an LTV ratio over 95.

testSuite.name: Precedence: Rule 1 over Rule 2
testSuite.description: When both Rule 1 and Rule 2 match, Rule 1 (Fixed30) takes precedence due to FIRST hit policy.

testSuite.name: Precedence: Rule 2 over Rule 3
testSuite.description: When both Rule 2 and Rule 3 match, Rule 2 (ARM7/1) takes precedence due to FIRST hit policy.

testSuite.name: Precedence: Rule 1 over Rule 3
testSuite.description: When both Rule 1 and Rule 3 match, Rule 1 (Fixed30) takes precedence due to FIRST hit policy.

testSuite.name: No Rule Applies
testSuite.description: Applicant does not meet criteria for any automated product.

testSuite.name: Rule 2 Boundary: Exact limits
testSuite.description: Testing boundary values for Rule 2 (horizonYears=7, LTV=80, creditScore=720).

testSuite.name: Rule 3 Boundary: Exact limits (No Match)
testSuite.description: Testing boundary values for Rule 3 (creditScore=640, DTI=50, LTV=95) which should not trigger ManualReview.

testSuite.name: Rule 2 Boundary: Horizon just above limit
testSuite.description: Horizon years slightly above 7 should not trigger Rule 2.

testSuite.name: Rule 3 Boundary: Credit score just below limit
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 triggers Rule 3.

testSuite.name: Rule 3 Boundary: DTI just above limit
testSuite.description: DTI 50.1 triggers Rule 3.

testSuite.name: Rule 3 Boundary: LTV just above limit
testSuite.description: LTV 95.1 triggers Rule 3.

testSuite.name: Null Values Handling
testSuite.description: Missing values for key parameters should result in no rule match if they are required for conditions.

testSuite.name: No Rule Match: Standard Applicant
testSuite.description: Applicant does not meet criteria for any specific rule

testSuite.name: No Rule Match: Null Values

Fixed30 через високу чутливість до ставки

Конфлікт ARM7/1 vs Fixed (пріоритет → Fixed30)
Виконуються умови ARM7/1, але fixedPreference=true → очікувано: Fixed30

ManualReview через низький кредитний бал
Очікувано: ManualReview (бо creditScore < 640)

ManualReview через високий DTI
Очікувано: ManualReview (бо dti > 50)

ManualReview через високий LTV
Очікувано: ManualReview (бо ltv > 95)

Нейтральний сценарій (жодне правило не підходить)
Очікувано: null або дефолтне рішення (залежно від політики у DMN)
Фіксована перевага + кредитний бал 600 → відсічка переважає
Фіксована перевага + DTI 55 → відсічка переважає
Фіксована перевага + LTV 97 → відсічка переважає
Висока чутливість до ставки + кредитний бал 620 → відсічка переважає

Висока чутливість до ставки + LTV 98 → відсічка переважає

Фіксована перевага, кредитний бал рівно 640 → Fixed30 (відсічки немає)

testSuite.name: Rule 1: Fixed Preference Trigger
testSuite.description: Applicant explicitly prefers a fixed rate. Rule 1 should trigger even if other rules match.

testSuite.name: Rule 1: High Rate Sensitivity Trigger
testSuite.description: Applicant has high rate sensitivity. Rule 1 should trigger.

testSuite.name: Rule 1 vs Rule 3 Precedence
testSuite.description: Applicant has high rate sensitivity (Rule 1) AND a very low credit score (Rule 3). Rule 1 must take precedence due to Hit Policy: FIRST.

testSuite.name: Rule 2: ARM 7/1 Standard Case
testSuite.description: Meets all criteria for ARM 7/1: horizon <= 7, stable income, LTV <= 80, and credit score >= 720.

testSuite.name: Rule 2: ARM 7/1 Boundary Case
testSuite.description: Meets all criteria for ARM 7/1 at the exact boundary values (7 years, 80% LTV, 720 score).

testSuite.name: Rule 2 vs Rule 3 Precedence
testSuite.description: Applicant meets ARM 7/1 criteria (Rule 2) but also has a DTI > 50 (Rule 3). Rule 2 must take precedence.

testSuite.name: Rule 3: Manual Review - Low Credit Score
testSuite.description: Credit score is below 640.

testSuite.name: Rule 3: Manual Review - High DTI
testSuite.description: DTI is over 50.

testSuite.name: Rule 3: Manual Review - High LTV
testSuite.description: LTV is over 95.

testSuite.name: No Rules Apply
testSuite.description: None of the conditions in Rule 1, 2, or 3 are met.

testSuite.name: Ambiguity: Missing LTV for Rule 2/3
testSuite.description: LTV is null. Rule 2 and Rule 3 cannot be evaluated for LTV. Expected behavior is no rule applied.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Mortgage Product Assignment">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="application.fixedPreference">

          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="application.rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>

      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="application.horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="application.incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>

        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.dti</text>

        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-1-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-2">
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">
          <text>"high"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-3">
          <text><= 7</text>

        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-4">

        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-5">

          <text></text>

        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-7">
          <text>> 50</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-5-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-6">
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-2">
          <text></text>

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>

          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
    </decisionTable>
  </decision>
</definitions>

testSuite.name: Rule 1: Fixed Preference
testSuite.description: Applicant explicitly prefers a fixed rate.

testSuite.name: Rule 1: High Rate Sensitivity
testSuite.description: Applicant has high sensitivity to rate changes.

testSuite.name: Rule 1: Both Conditions Met
testSuite.description: Both fixed preference and high sensitivity are true. Rule 1 should trigger.

testSuite.name: Rule 2: Typical ARM 7/1
testSuite.description: All conditions for ARM 7/1 are met.

testSuite.name: Rule 2: Boundary - Horizon 7 Years
testSuite.description: Horizon is exactly 7 years.

testSuite.name: Rule 2: Boundary - LTV 80%
testSuite.description: LTV is exactly 80%.

testSuite.name: Rule 2: Boundary - Credit Score 720
testSuite.description: Credit score is exactly 720.

testSuite.name: Rule 2: Fail - Horizon 8 Years
testSuite.description: Horizon is greater than 7 years.

testSuite.name: Rule 2: Fail - Variable Income
testSuite.description: Income stability is not stable.

testSuite.name: Rule 2: Fail - LTV 81%
testSuite.description: LTV is greater than 80%.

testSuite.name: Rule 2: Fail - Credit Score 719
testSuite.description: Credit score is less than 720.

testSuite.name: Rule 3: Low Credit Score
testSuite.description: Credit score is below 640.

testSuite.name: Rule 3: High DTI
testSuite.description: DTI is above 50.

testSuite.name: Rule 3: High LTV
testSuite.description: LTV is above 95.

testSuite.name: Rule 3: Boundary - Credit Score 640
testSuite.description: Credit score is exactly 640 (not below 640).

testSuite.name: Rule 3: Boundary - DTI 50%
testSuite.description: DTI is exactly 50 (not above 50).

testSuite.name: Rule 3: Boundary - LTV 95%
testSuite.description: LTV is exactly 95 (not above 95).

testSuite.name: Precedence: Rule 1 vs Rule 2
testSuite.description: Applicant meets Rule 2 criteria but also has Rule 1 preference. Rule 1 takes precedence.

testSuite.name: Precedence: Rule 1 vs Rule 3
testSuite.description: Applicant meets Rule 3 criteria but also has Rule 1 preference. Rule 1 takes precedence.

testSuite.name: Precedence: Rule 2 vs Rule 3
testSuite.description: Applicant meets Rule 3 criteria (LTV 96) but matches other Rule 2 criteria. Rule 2 fails due to LTV, so Rule 3 triggers.

testSuite.name: No Rule Matches: Mid Range
testSuite.description: Applicant does not trigger any specific rule.

testSuite.name: No Rule Matches: Null Values
testSuite.description: Required fields for rules are null.

<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Mortgage Product Assignment">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">

        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv != null then application.ltv else application.loan.amount / (if application.purpose = "purchase" and application.collateral.purchasePrice != null and application.collateral.appraisedValue != null then min(application.collateral.purchasePrice, application.collateral.appraisedValue) else if application.collateral.appraisedValue != null then application.collateral.appraisedValue else application.collateral.purchasePrice) * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.dti != null then application.dti else ((if application.housing.principalInterest = null then 0 else application.housing.principalInterest) + (if application.housing.taxes = null then 0 else application.housing.taxes) + (if application.housing.insurance = null then 0 else application.housing.insurance) + (if application.housing.hoa = null then 0 else application.housing.hoa) + (if application.housing.mip = null then 0 else application.housing.mip) + (if application.debts = null then 0 else sum(for d in application.debts return if d.include = false or d.monthlyPayment = null then 0 else d.monthlyPayment))) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>

    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>

      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">

      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv != null then application.ltv else if application.loan.amount != null and application.collateral.appraisedValue != null and application.collateral.appraisedValue > 0 then (application.loan.amount / (if application.purpose = "purchase" and application.collateral.purchasePrice != null then min(application.collateral.purchasePrice, application.collateral.appraisedValue) else application.collateral.appraisedValue) * 100) else null</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.dti != null then application.dti else if application.income.grossMonthly != null and application.income.grossMonthly > 0 then ((if application.housing.principalInterest = null then 0 else application.housing.principalInterest) + (if application.housing.taxes = null then 0 else application.housing.taxes) + (if application.housing.insurance = null then 0 else application.housing.insurance) + (if application.housing.hoa = null then 0 else application.housing.hoa) + (if application.housing.mip = null then 0 else application.housing.mip) + (if application.debts = null then 0 else sum(for d in application.debts return if d.include = false or d.monthlyPayment = null then 0 else d.monthlyPayment))) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100 else null</text>

testSuite.name: Rule 1: Fixed Preference
testSuite.description: Applicant explicitly prefers a fixed rate.

testSuite.name: Rule 1: High Rate Sensitivity
testSuite.description: Applicant has high sensitivity to rate changes.

testSuite.name: Rule 1 vs Rule 3: Precedence
testSuite.description: Rule 1 (Fixed30) should take precedence over Rule 3 (ManualReview) even if credit score is low.

testSuite.name: Rule 2: Standard ARM 7/1

testSuite.name: Rule 2: Boundary Horizon

testSuite.name: Rule 2: Boundary LTV
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 80% meets Rule 2 condition (<= 80).

testSuite.name: Rule 2: Boundary Credit Score
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 720 meets Rule 2 condition (>= 720).

testSuite.name: Rule 2 vs Rule 3: Precedence

testSuite.name: Rule 3: Low Credit Score
testSuite.description: Credit score below 640 triggers Manual Review.

testSuite.name: Rule 3: High DTI
testSuite.description: DTI above 50 triggers Manual Review.

testSuite.name: Rule 3: High LTV
testSuite.description: LTV above 95 triggers Manual Review.

testSuite.name: Rule 3: Boundary Credit 640
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 does not trigger Rule 3 (requires < 640) and doesn't match Rule 1 or 2.

testSuite.name: Rule 3: Boundary DTI 50
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 does not trigger Rule 3 (requires > 50).

testSuite.name: Rule 3: Boundary LTV 95
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 does not trigger Rule 3 (requires > 95).

testSuite.name: No Match Scenario
testSuite.description: No rules apply: credit score is okay, DTI is okay, LTV is okay, but horizon is too long for ARM.

testSuite.name: Rule 2 Fail (due to credit) triggers Rule 3
testSuite.description: Rule 2 fails because credit score is 600, which triggers Rule 3.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Decision Table Configuration">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv != null then application.ltv else application.loan.amount / application.collateral.appraisedValue * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.dti != null then application.dti else ((if application.housing.principalInterest != null then application.housing.principalInterest else 0) + (if application.housing.taxes != null then application.housing.taxes else 0) + (if application.housing.insurance != null then application.housing.insurance else 0) + (if application.housing.hoa != null then application.housing.hoa else 0) + (if application.housing.mip != null then application.housing.mip else 0) + (if application.debts != null then sum(for d in application.debts return (if d.include != false and d.monthlyPayment != null then d.monthlyPayment else 0)) else 0)) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />
      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">
          <text>true</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-1-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-2">
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">
          <text>"high"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-3">
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-3">
          <text><= 7</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-4">
          <text>"stable"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-5">
          <text><= 80</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-6">
          <text>>= 720</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-3-output-1">
          <text>"ARM7/1"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-4">
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-6">
          <text>< 640</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-4-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-5">
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-7">
          <text>> 50</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-5-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-6">
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-5">
          <text>> 95</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-6-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
    </decisionTable>
  </decision>
</definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Decision Table Configuration">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv != null then application.ltv else application.loan.amount / (if application.collateral.purchasePrice != null and application.collateral.appraisedValue != null then min(application.collateral.purchasePrice, application.collateral.appraisedValue) else if application.collateral.appraisedValue != null then application.collateral.appraisedValue else application.collateral.purchasePrice) * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.dti != null then application.dti else (sum([application.housing.principalInterest, application.housing.taxes, application.housing.insurance, application.housing.hoa, application.housing.mip]) + (if application.debts != null then sum(for d in application.debts return if d.include = false then 0 else d.monthlyPayment) else 0)) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />
      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">
          <text>true</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-1-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-2">
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">
          <text>"high"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-3">
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-3">
          <text><= 7</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-4">
          <text>"stable"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-5">
          <text><= 80</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-6">
          <text>>= 720</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-3-output-1">
          <text>"ARM7/1"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-4">
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-6">
          <text>< 640</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-4-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-5">
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-7">
          <text>> 50</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-5-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-6">
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-3">

    </decisionTable>
  </decision>
</definitions>

testSuite.description: Income instability prevents ARM 7/1.
